description: FINE-TUNING on DIBCO with TILING AUGMENTATION (461 samples from 152 source images, 3.0x augmentation). Combines dataset expansion with increased LR for better domain adaptation. Loads thin_stroke_preservation_v1_academic checkpoint, visual-only training (no CTC). Strategy: Maximize data diversity through tiling + higher LR for faster adaptation.

experiment_metadata.hypothesis: Tiling augmentation (3.0x dataset expansion) + increased LR (2x from baseline fine-tuning) will achieve superior domain adaptation to REAL historical documents compared to baseline fine-tuning.

advantages: Preserves fine details from large images (no extreme scaling)
Enables sliding window inference for full-page reconstruction
Diverse tile positions = more training data

training_strategy.lr_increase: From 0.00005 → 0.0001 (2x). Rationale: More data (461 samples) supports higher LR without overfitting. Faster domain adaptation.
training_strategy.lr_schedule: ENABLED with warmup (3 epochs) + annealing (10 epochs). Gradual increase prevents shock, cosine decay prevents overshooting.
training_strategy.batch_size_4: Same as baseline. With dual GPU training, batch 4 is max safe size to avoid OOM (16GB GPU limit).
training_strategy.epochs_50: Extended from 20 to 50. More data needs more iterations to fully learn. Early stopping (patience=12) prevents waste.
training_strategy.patience_12: Increased from 8 to 12. Real data has higher variance, needs more tolerance.
training_strategy.dropout_0.15: Increased from 0.1 to 0.15. Stronger regularization for larger dataset.
training_strategy.visual_only: CTC=0, rec_feat=0. DIBCO has NO text labels, pure binarization.

expected_outcome.epoch_10_target: PSNR >23 dB (if not reached, training likely failing again)
expected_outcome.final_target: PSNR 26-28 dB (realistic given synthetic→real domain gap)
expected_outcome.visual_quality: White pixel ratio should drop from 85-99% to <70%. Text strokes preserved.
expected_outcome.success_criteria: PSNR >25 dB + visual inspection shows readable text

risk_mitigation.overfitting: More data (461 samples) + dropout 0.15 + early stopping
risk_mitigation.catastrophic_forgetting: Still relatively low LR (0.0001) + warmup prevents shock
risk_mitigation.domain_shift: Tiling provides diverse views of real degradation patterns
